description: Fondazione IPRES publishes puglia municipal waste generation and separate collection, 2018–2024. Municipal waste information for 2018–2024 covers urban-waste generation and separate collection. Reported indicators include the separate-collection percentage and per-capita quantities of total and separately collected urban waste. ISPRA is the underlying source. Facility locations, collection routes and material-level table fields are not established by the inspected metadata. Coverage is the Puglia region of Italy. The native catalogue provides CSV and spreadsheet distributions, with some linked visualisations. These alternative representations remain one resource; file contents and data rows were not inspected. The native licence is Creative Commons Attribution without a stated version. The national metadata mirror specifies version 4.0; the native statement remains unversioned. Metadata access is public, while file-use charges and restrictions are not established. Completeness and numerical accuracy are unverified. No specific simulation use is assigned. Related national and regional catalogue representations are treated as the same publication only where their exact source identities match.
